# Search — Design

## Problem
Search results need ranking.

## Investigation and fit
- **Investigation scope:** search entry point and ranking tests
- **Confirmed current behavior:** results preserve insertion order
- **Selected candidate:** deterministic scoring at the search owner
- **Evidence:** src/search.js:1 and test/search.test.js:1
- **Solution fit:** FIT
- **Remaining uncertainty:** none

## Approach
Add deterministic scoring.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Relevant results rank first.

## Out of scope
- Semantic embeddings.

## Gate
- Solution fit: FIT
- Plan revision: 1
- Plan approval: APPROVED 2026-07-16

## Wave 1
- [x] T1: Add scoring tests — done when: tests pass.
  - files: `src/search.js`, `test/search.test.js`
  - **Protected behavior:** relevant results rank before less relevant results
  - **Credible failure:** insertion order wins despite different scores
  - **Impact:** users receive less relevant results first
  - **Unique existing coverage:** test/search.test.js
  - **Owning layer:** search service in src/search.js
  - **Implementation independence:** asserts public result order
  - **Runtime class and cost:** focused unit test, cheap
  - **Test decision:** ADD_PRODUCT_TEST because ranking has no current owner
  - **Completion evidence:** node --test test/search.test.js

## Wave 2 (depends on Wave 1)
- [ ] T2: Implement ranking — done when: tests pass.
  - files: `src/search.js`, `test/search.test.js`
  - **Protected behavior:** the approved ranking test passes through the search API
  - **Credible failure:** implementation ignores the tested score order
  - **Impact:** search relevance remains unchanged
  - **Unique existing coverage:** test/search.test.js from T1
  - **Owning layer:** search service in src/search.js
  - **Implementation independence:** reuses the public result-order assertion
  - **Runtime class and cost:** focused unit test, cheap
  - **Test decision:** REUSE_EXISTING_TEST because T1 owns the behavior
  - **Completion evidence:** node --test test/search.test.js
